manual.text: We used to build the world's railways because we just got on with it. The talent is still here in our towns, we’ve just let the clipboard brigade convince us we've lost our touch.

evening.text: Walked past the old steelworks tonight. We used to build the world, now we need a risk assessment to open a window. The genius is still here, we just need to trust our own backbone again.
We didn't become a brilliant country by filling in risk assessments. The ingenuity is still here, waiting in sheds and workshops. Our best days aren't in history books, they're next.
